idea-plugin.name: Kubernetes RBAC Wildcard Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Warning on a Role/ClusterRole rule that combines a wildcard ("*") in verbs or resources with a sensitive resource -- secrets, pods/exec, clusterrolebindings. This is the most common path to privilege escalation after a single pod is compromised in a cluster (OWASP Kubernetes Top 10, K03 -- Overly Permissive RBAC Configurations).

100% static text analysis -- an indentation-based line scanner, not a real YAML parser, so it works whether the real Kubernetes/YAML plugin is installed or not. Handles both list shapes YAML allows for resources/verbs: flow style (resources: ["secrets"]) and block style (resources: followed by - secrets on its own line).

Stated honestly: v0.1 only scans Role/ ClusterRole manifests in the standard rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1 shape -- it never resolves a RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding to know who is actually granted the permission, only flags the dangerous rule itself.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Overly permissive RBAC wildcard on a sensitive resource
